name: manual_8c228d
claim: On Windows fsnotify remove or rename events, retain watcher ownership and budget cleanup but do not call the native Remove API again for an already invalidated watch: the redundant call can block watcher shutdown. Prove the event-ordering fix with a regression that observes no second native removal.

decisions.notes: Separated from lesson_757476abb44e so its verified watcher-deadlock root cause remains available after the authorization-only supersession.
